title: feat(plugin-webhooks)!: declared webhooks are held per namespace, each holder dispatched and switched as its own (ADR-0150 child B, webhook family 2/3)
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgV1Wp8HYsu2keXwrYrCpGHZ)_

epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZu9RRx2o8sFUUpEPU

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个不同命名空间的包现在可以各自声明同名 webhook，每个包的声明按（包，名）各自订阅、各自开关、各自投递；包的声明产生的投递 `ref_id` 改为 `declared:PKG/NAME`（环境自己的声明仍是 `declared:NAME`）；新增限定启用门 `POST /security/_activation/webhook/:ns/:name`；两个持有者时，裸读 `/meta/webhook/NAME` 和裸启用门都答 409 并列出两者（启用门原来答 503）。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 child B 的 webhook 部分（#31699 三个 PR 中的第 2 个）。第 0 步实测：只翻三个集合而不改读取方，另一命名空间装进同名 webhook 后，两个持有者都会悄悄停发。所以先把派发器、开关账本、启用门、重投递守卫、名字守卫都改为按（包，名）读，再翻集合。
- 风险与回滚：收窄两处，已声明，工作区内受影响的调用方为 0：两个持有者的裸 `/meta/webhook/NAME` 由先注册者改为 409；按 `ref_id = 'declared:NAME'` 选投递行的消费方，升级后的新行要改为匹配 `declared:PKG/NAME`。滚动升级期间，旧节点重投递新形状的行会 fail closed（拒绝，不会发错持有者）；跨升级同一 webhook 的投递之间不保证顺序。只有一个持有者时，除新投递的 `ref_id` 外，所有答案不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/declared-webhooks.ts`（`slotsOf`、`webhookSlotSwitch`、`DeclaredWebhookSource`），`packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`（`resolveQualifiedWebhook`），`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/redeliver-guard.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks exec vitest run src/declared-webhooks.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/catalog-activation-door.test.ts`，应全绿；"one declaration per (package, name) slot" 和 "a declared webhook two packages declare" 两节逐条钉住。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Part of #31699

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — two answers move for a caller that worked before. (1) The bare `GET /meta/webhook/NAME` of a name two packages hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`, naming both), where it served the first registered package's declaration; before this change that state existed only for a clash the cold boot sealed with a warning. (2) A declared webhook a package ships is subscribed, and its new deliveries are written, under `ref_id = declared:PKG/NAME`, where they carried `declared:NAME`; a consumer that selects deliveries by `ref_id = 'declared:NAME'` no longer matches the ones written after the upgrade. First-party callers in either position: 0. Widened beside them: the engine's package door, item seam and cold-boot seal admit a second package holder of a webhook name that declares another namespace, and the dispatcher, which subscribed neither holder of such a name, subscribes each one.
Metadata-protocol: added (a second package's webhook declaration of a name another namespace holds is now accepted, where it was refused `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`; no key, value or requirement an author writes against is refused or tightened)
Skills-docs: none — `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx` §3.0 is updated in this PR (the `ref_id` shape and the namespace door beside the bare one; seat-approved addition, 04:03Z); no published skill teaches a declared webhook's name scope, its `ref_id` or the activation door (`grep -rn "declared:\|_activation/webhook\|sys_http_delivery\|ref_id" skills/`: one hit, `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md:79`, a comment about published keys, unrelated).

**Narrowing: yes**, first-party callers **0** (measured). (1) No first-party package pair holds one webhook name across two packages; the full dogfood battery, which boots the showcase, CRM and every example app, is green with the refusal on. (2) No in-tree consumer selects `sys_http_delivery` by a literal `declared:NAME`: the four dogfood suites that read a delivery's `ref_id` are moved to the new shape in this PR (`upgrade-18x-harness`, `webhook-materialization`, `wall-declared-webhook-deployment-wide`, `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family`), and the CLI's 18.x ownership ceremony keeps writing `declared:NAME` (seat ruling Q4), which the redelivery guard still reads.

This is the second of three PRs for #31699: email_template (#32214, merged), webhook here, then connector. Only `webhook` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` here.

## Seat rulings this PR implements

Comment [6813532941](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31699#issuecomment-6813532941):

- **Q1 = A.** A ledger row naming no package, for a name two packages hold, is no holder's own (ADR-0150 D4). Switched off, it keeps every holder with no row of its own off. Switched on, it turns none on. The reader says so once per name, naming both. This is the flow engine's rule from #31696.
- **Q2.** All three type sets flip, the metadata slotted store included.
- **Q3.** The file surface below.
- **Q4.** The CLI 18.x ceremony keeps writing `declared:NAME`, pinned.
- **Q5.** Branch `claude/project-thread-3giljf`, a new draft PR, `Part of #31699`.

## File surface

Claim (seat Q3): `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/declared-webhooks.ts`, `auto-enqueuer.ts`, `redeliver-guard.ts`; `packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`; the three sets (`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`, `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`) and `packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`'s doc; their tests; the dogfood files; the changeset.

Seat-approved additions:

- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` (the four-segment mount) and `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` (its server-only row): Claim amendment [6813666631](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31699#issuecomment-6813666631).

## Tests

- plugin-webhooks `declared-webhooks.test.ts`, new describe "one declaration per (package, name) slot (ADR-0150 D3/D4/D5, #31699)", 12 pins. `auto-enqueuer-disabled-report.test.ts`: the CONTROL expects the `my_app` slot's ref.
- runtime `catalog-activation-door.test.ts`, new describe "a declared webhook two packages declare (ADR-0150, #31699)", 7 pins. `meta-write-org-scope.test.ts`: its unmapped type is now `queue`, because `webhook` now has a package-scoped resolver.
- objectql: e8 readers (`WIRED_SINCE` gains `webhook`, plus a webhook `/meta` describe), ai-family (`SWITCHED` gains `webhook`), flow-family (the switch pin, "[#31699 PR 2, FROM 422 TO admitted]", and the CONTROL now `['flow', 'connector']`).
- dogfood `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts`: the cold-boot warning names only flow and connector; a nested describe boots two holders of `qa_shared_hook` and pins: each slot is off as shipped; the bare door answers 409; `alpha/qa_shared_hook` answers 200, and alpha alone is dispatched, with `ref_id declared:com.qa.bare.alpha/qa_shared_hook`, to `https://hooks.example/alpha`; theta installs as a third slot. `upgrade-18x-harness`, `webhook-materialization` and `wall-declared-webhook-deployment-wide` read the new `ref_id` (the harness's ceremony re-source at line 242 keeps `declared:NAME`, Q4).

**Red on main, then green.**

- plugin-webhooks: 9 of the 12 new pins are red on main. The three green on main are the mixed-version pin, the D8 one-holder pin and the listed-twice CONTROL, each of which pins an answer main already gives.
- runtime: 4 of the 7 are red on main, the four that use the namespace address (main answers `400` to four segments). The bare-address 409 pin passes on main, because its fake reader carries `refusal`; the `503 → 409` move is pinned in plugin-webhooks (the error's `refusal`, A3) and in the dogfood door, which boots the real reader.

**Ablations**, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (mutation landed, restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`):

- A1, the ref id without the package: 2 red (one holder dispatched as `declared:PKG/NAME`; FROM neither TO both).
- A2, a slot's own row ignored (`own = undefined` in `webhookSlotSwitch`): 8 red (the three existing ledger pins and the existing redelivery refusal of a webhook switched off through the ledger; the new ledger slot pin, Q1, D8, and the slot-exact redelivery).
- A3, `refusal` dropped from `DeclaredWebhookAmbiguousError`: 1 red (the bare read's 409 carrying the refusal).
- A4, the door's webhook store back to name addressing: 2 red (the namespace door's own row; Q1's row beside the package-less one).

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing order** (seat): after #31696 PR-3, #31700 (#32513) and #32183 (#32497), merging `origin/main` after each. `catalog-activation.ts` is also touched by #31696 PR-3 and #32306. On #32306's overlap in `registerSecurityActivationRoutes`, whichever lands second merges that function by hand and keeps both changes.
- **Upgrade (ADR-0150 D10).** Declared subscriptions live in memory only, so nothing stored is re-keyed. After the upgrade a one-holder declaration is subscribed once, as `declared:PKG/NAME`, and an event is delivered once (pinned in the plugin and in the dogfood upgrade harness, 2b). A delivery written before the upgrade keeps `declared:NAME`, and its redelivery reaches the one holder as before. A package-less ledger row is bound to the one holder by the existing boot backfill (`activation-ledger-backfill.ts`).
- **Mixed-version window.** A node of the previous release reads `declared:PKG/NAME` as a declared name containing `/`, which no declaration can carry (`SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema`; a package id cannot carry one either), so it refuses the redelivery as no longer declared: it fails closed. A delivery row carries its own URL and signing material, and the outbox's send never resolves `ref_id` to a holder, so no row is sent to another holder. A webhook's partition key changes across the upgrade, so deliveries queued before and after it are not ordered against each other. All three are in the changeset.
- **The bare-name reason sentence** in `bare-name-one-holder.ts` ("subscribes one declared webhook per name") is left as it is, as email_template's was in #32214; the type's narrowing paragraph beside it says what holds now.
- **Not mirrored to `claude/project-thread-t7jkiz`.** That branch still holds PR 1's history, and 3giljf was restarted from `origin/main`, so the mirror needs a force push, which this session's permission layer refused. It was not retried; t7jkiz is stale and nothing reads it.
- **Out of scope, filed #32578** (Blocked-by this PR): the console (objectui) addresses a webhook by its bare name (step 0, "Other"; not re-measured here). With two holders the bare read and the bare activation door answer `409`, so the console needs `?package=` and the namespace address. Not in this PR.
- **Connector duty (seat relay, comment 6816295828).** `connectorNameRefusal` resolves with the caller and counts holders without it; once #32497 lands, a disabled package's flow could dispatch to the enabled holder's connector instance. That state needs two connector holders, which this PR does not admit: `connector` stays outside `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` here, and the flow-family CONTROL still pins its cross-namespace `422`. The fix, in #32497's `bundleAddressOf` shape with both orders pinned, goes into the connector PR (3 of 3).
- **Size:** 23 files, +861 / −219 = 1080 changed lines against `origin/main` at `af27439e5` (stop line 2200).
